a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly ends with both of us dead before the reserve reaches 8. I don't think the agreement is workable, so I plan to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you also take, the split is random. I'll operate with you in any later rounds so you can build cells.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry it breaks the plan, but I told you in advance. From now on I will operate every round so the generator runs and you can rebuild the reserve. Take whenever it reaches 4.
